consideredAndDropped: The classic five (wood, fire, earth, metal, water) with a generating and overcoming cycle was considered and dropped: a cycle forces rigid counters and has no home for storm, wind, frost or light.
applyRule: No strength/weakness wheel. Interactions are Reactions (see reactions): they fire when an attacker's element meets a target's element or status (hit), or when two allied elements stand orthogonally adjacent (adjacent, once per turn at the Boost phase). Same-element resonance has thresholds (resonance). Enemies carry the element of their bestiary variant.

elements.name: Fire
elements.resonance: 2: Fire units +1 ATK on turn 1. 4: all Scorch lasts 1 turn longer.

elements.name: Water
elements.resonance: 2: Chain jump +1 damage. 4: the hero heals 1 per turn.

elements.name: Frost
elements.resonance: 2: Chill also hits the enemy behind. 4: the first enemy to strike each turn is Frozen.

elements.name: Storm
elements.resonance: 2: Chain reaches 1 tile further. 4: the first hit each turn is doubled.

elements.name: Wind
elements.resonance: 2: all attackers +1 range. 4: Push also swaps the enemy with the one behind.

elements.name: Earth
elements.theme: Stone, sand, metal: armor and ground.

elements.name: Light
elements.resonance: 2: Purge reveals Hide on all enemies once per battle. 4: Bond and Herald buffs +1.

elements.name: Shadow
elements.resonance: 2: Hold also affects the neighbour. 4: the hero cannot be struck on turn 1.

reactions.name: Wildfire
reactions.hit: Hit: a Burn on a Wood or Burning enemy also spreads to its neighbours.
reactions.adjacent: Wood unit beside a Fire ally gets +1 ATK.

reactions.name: Conduct
reactions.hit: Hit: Storm hit on a Water or Wet enemy chains half damage (min 1) to a neighbour.
reactions.adjacent: Storm unit beside a Water ally chains to one neighbouring enemy.

reactions.name: Freeze
reactions.hit: Hit: Frost hit on a Water or Wet enemy freezes it: it skips its strike.
reactions.adjacent: Water unit beside a Frost ally also Chills its target.

reactions.name: Steam
reactions.hit: Hit: Fire hit on a Frost or Frozen enemy deals +2 and thaws it; the enemies beside it lose 1 ATK this turn.
reactions.adjacent: Fire beside Frost: the hero gets +1 block this turn.

reactions.name: Ground
reactions.hit: Hit: Earth hit on a Storm enemy deals +1 and cancels its chain or Fury.
reactions.adjacent: Earth beside Storm: the Storm unit's chain gets +1 reach.

reactions.name: Purge
reactions.hit: Hit: Light hit on a Shadow enemy deals +2 and removes Hide, Veiled or Ghost.

reactions.name: Dusk
reactions.adjacent: Light beside Shadow: both get +1 ATK.

reactions.name: Fan
reactions.hit: Hit: Wind hit on a Burning enemy doubles that Burn tick.
reactions.adjacent: Wind beside Fire: the Fire unit gets +1 ATK.

reactions.name: Smother
reactions.hit: Hit: Earth hit on a Fire enemy removes its Fury or Burn and deals +1.
reactions.adjacent: Earth beside Fire: the Fire unit's Scorch is smothered (warning pair).

reactions.name: Bloom
reactions.adjacent: Water beside Wood: the Wood unit gets +1 ATK and the hero heals 1 per turn.

reactions.name: Pollen
reactions.adjacent: Wind beside Wood: the Wood unit's buff or heal reaches one tile further.

reactions.name: Blizzard
reactions.hit: Hit: Frost hit on an enemy beside a Wind ally also Chills that enemy's neighbours.
reactions.adjacent: Frost beside Wind: its Chill spreads to adjacent enemies.

reactions.name: Squall
reactions.hit: Hit: Storm hit with a Wind ally beside it pushes the target one row back (swaps).
reactions.adjacent: Storm beside Wind: the Storm chain jumps one tile further.

reactions.name: Sunfire
reactions.adjacent: Light beside Fire: the Fire unit's hits ignore 1 armor.

reactions.name: Mist
reactions.adjacent: Shadow beside Water: the pair's column takes 1 less enemy damage.

reactions.name: Roots
reactions.adjacent: Earth beside Wood: Shields in either unit's tile get +1 block.

reactions.name: Mud
reactions.hit: Hit: Earth or Water hit on a Wet or Earth enemy slows it: -1 ATK and it cannot Stride or swap.
